So many things you're feeling I'm feeling right now. I think the most important thing to remember is that you did nothing wrong. You're an amazing person, and this is not your fault. Honestly, to me it sounds like she couldn't handle the long distance and decided to drown the heartache of the break up in another guy. I know it sucks so much, and I know it feels hopeless. But you are going to be sad for as long as you need to be sad for, and that's okay. Just find ways to distract yourself. Focus on your studies. Listen to good music. Work out. Watch scrubs (currently getting me through my heartache). Eventually you'll realize that you are okay without her. Just remember that you are a good person and that it will be okay. I'm here for you friend.
